title: Choose the next external Kanban task
description: Pick the next open bead to tackle on this Jira/cross-app Kanban branch after the current async workspace-metrics fix is resolved.

allowCodeFileChanges.label: Allow the agent to proceed after I submit
allowCodeFileChanges.description: If checked, the next agent may start implementing the selected task after reading your response. Leave unchecked if you only want discussion/planning.

questions.title: Which bead should we tackle next?
questions.description: Relevant open beads for this branch are listed here. My recommendation is to finish the in-progress async metrics fix first, then add OTEL/performance tracing so future slowdowns are easier to prove.

choices.label: vkvw-yugp — Load external Kanban workspace metrics asynchronously
choices.description: Finish the current in-progress fix so the Jira board endpoint stops hanging on workspace metrics.
choices.is_recommended_reason: This addresses the active regression and should unblock real manual testing.

choices.label: vkvw-fteh — Add OTEL instrumentation and profile Jira board loading performance
choices.description: Add tracing/metrics around Jira fetch, auth, workspace metrics, task decoration, and rendering to identify bottlenecks.
choices.is_recommended_reason: Best next step after vkvw-yugp because it gives objective performance visibility.

choices.label: vkvw-qstt — Refactor external Jira Kanban integration into plugin module
choices.description: Move the feature under src/modules/plugins/kanban and kanban/jira while preserving current behavior.

choices.label: vkvw-9alt — Create associated bead when linking ticket and workspace
choices.description: Create/link a task before workspace creation so the workspace agent has external issue context.

choices.label: vkvw-09uu — Add external tracker sign-in and Jira connect UI
choices.description: Add visible login/connect Jira UI for the OAuth path instead of relying on bot-token env setup.

choices.label: vkvw-kdlj — Add VK bulk workspace activity summary API for external Kanban
choices.description: Replace N+1 workspace/session calls with a bulk VK summary API including agent message counts.

choices.label: vkvw-opww — Map external tracker projects to default repos for workspace creation
choices.description: Map Jira projects to default VK repos/branches for future Create Workspace behavior.

choices.label: vkvw-tfhv — Associate external tickets with existing VK workspaces
choices.description: Add UI to explicitly link Jira cards to existing VK workspaces.

choices.label: vkvw-tngb — Add editable JQL filter to external Jira board view
choices.description: Let users edit a safe project-scoped Jira query/filter from within VD.

choices.label: vkvw-5kf2 — Add Backlog and Done column visibility controls
choices.description: Add simple view controls for hiding/showing Backlog and Done columns.

choices.label: vkvw-36fy — Show empty Jira columns in external Kanban
choices.description: Improve display of empty Jira columns where provider metadata makes that possible.

choices.label: vkvw-ghrw — Support multi-value Jira issueParent URL filters
choices.description: Support multiple issueParent ids in Jira URLs while preserving query safety.

questions.title: Ordering notes
questions.description: If you want a different sequence, explain it here. For example: finish async metrics, then OTEL, then plugin refactor.

questions.title: Success criteria or constraints
questions.description: Any constraints the agent should honor for the selected task? Include manual test URLs, performance expectations, or product priorities.
